takeaways: The series documents building a C compiler called paella in Zig, based on Nora Sandler's Writing a C Compiler.
It is organized into 10 chapters: Intro, Unary, Binary, Logic, Variables, Conditions, Blocks, Loops, Functions, and Linking.
The author wrote it as a way to learn Zig, and the posts are unedited.
The author says more chapters will be posted if they continue the book.
summary.summary: This is a personal blog series in which the author builds a C compiler named paella in Zig, following Nora Sandler's book Writing a C Compiler. The page lists ten chapter write-ups, covering topics from an intro through unary and binary operators, logic, variables, conditions, blocks, loops, functions, and linking. The author describes it as both a way to learn Zig and a side project during a job search, and says the posts are published as originally written, with only broken links fixed. The page itself contains no code or technical detail; the content lives in the linked chapters.
